architectureDecisions: Modular monolith/PG authoritative; P0/P1/P2/P3 unchanged except publication-safe integration boundaries.
Immutable typed canonical JSON binds actual artifact checksums/evidence, metadata, exact connection+generation, explicit visibility and intended schedule; no paths/secrets/auth caches.
Connection revision rotates on credential/scope/status/revocation change; old account approvals cannot transfer to a reconnected row.
Single existing local-user operator approval is separate from P3 fixtures and agent runtime identity; expiry/revoke/replay/metadata changes fail closed. Historical approved_at grants nothing.
Only PublicationSafety creates an upload permit; all manual/scheduler/retry/provider calls use it. Atomic target claim/dispatch token plus current-byte/source rechecks.
Bounded exact-size hashed snapshot stays OS-locked/open through upload. Provider reads that handle, not mutable source paths.
Production first checks real feature flag; explicit test-only duration constructor on loopback is MOCK_ONLY, never selectable via HTTP/environment mode toggle.
YouTube uses bound connection and exact scope, explicit manifest visibility/metadata; confirmation matches returned post ID and privacy. Other adapters remain NOT_CONFIGURED.
Unknown transfer/restart without ID is durable quarantine with no blind resend. Known IDs may be confirmed without another upload; no arbitrary attach/clear API.
UI checksum-verifies actual media preview; dirty/historical/unverified revisions cannot be approved; no auto approve or fake real-mode publish success.
limits: No live social upload, Telegram enablement, provider login/account switching, autonomous coding, arbitrary-shell product task, main merge, production deployment, public ingress or five-hour schedule.
Provider acceptance is MOCK_ONLY. Actual media/Windows process/browser/backend persistence evidence is separate from provider-live verification.
Local bearer identifies one local-user operator; no new multi-user RBAC or live channel ownership attestation.
Conservative expiry/revocation/account-change after an upload may leave known-ID confirmation blocked; operator reconciliation contract is future work.
Unknown outcomes cannot be blindly resent or cleared via API. No manual arbitrary post-ID attach/reconciliation API was added.
Manifest/source immutability constrains deletion; approved retention/credential lifecycle is a P5 prerequisite.
